text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp began once again this year. Designed to
hone the Umamusume's skills, nearly every currently enrolled
student participated in this camp, and—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Verxina-senpai...!
Good afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "Your Victoria Mile was so moving...! We're aiming for the Tiara route too..."

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: "I want to become a beautiful, elegant, and strong Umamusume, just like you, Senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
Good luck to you all, too.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Thank you so veeery much!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~, got some encouragementâ¡
Let's do our best at the training camp too!
choice_data_list: She's like that admired senior, huh.
She's like that admired senior, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Please, stop teasing me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“Still, having so many girls who look up to me
is something I am truly grateful for.”

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "That is what a true queen ought to be. ...Not one who simply seeks power alone for herself."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Just like that person.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I've heard talk lately that she's been
a bit off her game. I don't hear as many rumors about her as I used to."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a personality that flaunted her own strength,
and a running style that cared for nothing in the pursuit of victory,
she naturally tended to make enemies—

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
âJust look at Verxina-kun's
noble demeanor. Her juniors adore her, too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to that, Gentildonna-san...
I despise her philosophy that strength excuses everything.
Winners have an influence on the next generation, after all."

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Her recent slump is just payback for running rampant as she pleased.
I really feel for the other girls of her generation, all because she had so much power—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...My, what dreadful things to say.
choice_data_list: …You don’t like the way she carries herself either?
...Do you not like the way she carries herself either?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No flowers bloom in the wake of her run.
She siphons everything, turning it into her own power...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: However...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
I couldn't help but overhear your conversation.

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
!?
Wh-What is it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I appreciate your praise.
However—would you kindly refrain from using it as a tool to belittle Gentile-san?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that person is arrogant, haughty,
and devoted solely to pursuing power with zero regard
for anyone else... Truly a terrifying individual.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However, we are Umamusume.
Carrying an insatiable fighting spirit,
we hold victory as the supreme honor—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become strong.
That is why I train more than anyone else.
That is why I think more deeply than anyone else."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...So that I may remain "absolute,"
I shall keep challenging the strong, the world... and myself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
“—Striving to defeat everything in my path.
What about that is strange to you?”

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you saying you approve
of Gentildonna's behavior, then?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No.
However, I shall not deny it either.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If we are to judge right from wrong, the only means is through victory.
Please do not worry.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat her,
and build a pure, righteous, and beautiful future.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why, everyone—
you just need to watch over me."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right... And also,
we don't feel sorry for ourselves in the least.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
They possess a stellar brilliance
that is every bit the equal of hers.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Please, enjoy what is yet to come.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with Verxina's smile,
the trainers fell completely silent.
And I, too, learned of her true feelings for the first time—
choice_data_list: (I truly respect Gentil from the bottom of my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reflecting once more on Verxina's feelings
toward her rival...
another intense summer training camp begins.
